sources.title: Contoso Dental backup arrangement
paragraphs: Contoso Dental chart data is copied nightly to a cloud backup service.
The imaging server is included in the nightly backup.
Reference phrase for this record: zebra-cq-canary-5521.

sources.title: Contoso Dental shared mailbox
paragraphs: Three front desk staff share one mailbox at Contoso Dental.
The practice manager approves mailbox access requests.
